items.title: Ackman unveils six new investments including Netflix, Visa, Mastercard in portfolio overhaul
items.summary: Bill Ackman unveiled six new holdings, including Netflix, Visa and Mastercard, marking the billionaire investor's biggest portfolio overhaul in years.  Ackman said on Thursday he acquired shares starting in the second ‌quarter that will be held in his investment funds, including his newest offering Pershing Square USA, which was listed ‌on the New York Stock Exchange in April.  Along with Netflix, which Ackman held briefly in 2022 before selling at a loss, his funds are also investing in ​eye care firm Alcon, exchange operator Intercontinental Exchange and financial data provider S&P Global.

items.title: Bill Ackman Unveils Six New Stock Picks
items.summary: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square made investments in six new public companies since the end of March:  Visa   Mastercard   Netflix   S&P Global   Intercontinental Exchange   Alcon   The additions were disclosed in a letter to shareholders that accompanied Pershing Square’s quarterly earnings release, the firm’s first since it went public in April.
